post_text: Social video narration: 'Spring Bar is my favorite stop for pintxos and a full dinner. I recommend it for the anchovy toast and the kitchen, not for cocktails.' The only visible sign reads Spring Bar.
Social video narration: 'The Campbell is a gorgeous cocktail lounge. Come for the martinis and the drink program; this is my nightlife recommendation.' The sign reads The Campbell.
Post caption: 'Save Little Ember Café for its espresso and pour-over coffee. There are pastries and sandwiches too, but the coffee is why I keep returning.'
Post caption: 'Alain Ducasse Chocolate & Glace is a dessert shop I recommend for handmade chocolates and ice cream. There is no full restaurant menu or coffee program.'
Video narration: 'Go see Giacometti in the Temple of Dendur, the special exhibition at The Met. The show itself is my recommendation; The Met is the venue, not a second recommendation.'
